items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: as far as I know about him. I think he had a pretty good rating as far as his playing, but otherwise I wouldn't know.

ctx.x: Brass bands, yeah, they played hymns.

But never a regular band. Never a regular band. Well how would somebody like Kid Thomas rate then? Well I'll tell you about him, as far as I know about him. I think he had a pretty good rating as far as his playing, but otherwise I wouldn't know. Well he played good. Yeah, but I mean he was known on this side of the river at that time?
